content.title: Volato and M2i to develop Strategic Minerals Reserve in Nevada, US
content.summary: The SMR is proposed to be located at the Hawthorne Army Depot in Mineral County, Nevada.

thumbnail.caption: The initiative follows a report by the Hoover Institution advocating for a US-led critical minerals stockpile. Credit: William Potter/Shutterstock.com.

content.title: Inky Appoints New CEO to Board of Directors
content.summary: Inky ( (MTWO) ) has provided an update. M2i Global, Inc. has appointed its CEO, Maj. Gen. (Ret) Alberto Rosende, to its Board of Directors, strengthening its mission to secure critical minerals and metals essential for national defense and economic security. With vast experience in both military and global payments industries, Rosende is set to drive M2i’s growth, leveraging public-private partnerships and expanding global relationships for strategic mineral reserves.
